responsibility: This pipeline description models the E8 NDS32 core for the scheduler. It declares the E8 automaton units, reservation latencies for ALU, load/store, multiple-word memory, multiply, MAC, divide, and branch classes, and the bypass rules that describe when values from loads, post-update addresses, and multiword memory operations become available to consumers, allowing GCC’s automaton scheduler to estimate issue timing and hazards specifically for the E8 microarchitecture.
